name: Residual Block with Shortcut (ReLU MLP Extension)
aliases: Analytic Marching with TResBlk and Shortcut Connections
definition: An extension of the analytic marching analysis to MLPs with residual blocks containing shortcut connections.
summary: This method extends analytic marching to residual MLPs with shortcut connections, enabling exact linear region partitioning by handling additive shortcuts rather than concatenation.
